note: Measured rates for shot_router.estimate (3E.4). Sources: KIE's own records for 119 tasks (2026-11-23) and the 27-piece OmniHuman 2.0 test. A credit is half a cent. A failed job costs 0 and is never a line here. Lengths not in a table are flagged TIME_UNMEASURED_LENGTH, not guessed.
picture_note: A Sunburst picture is 12.4 to 13.1 credits; 13.1 (the high end) is used so an estimate never understates. Every keyframe is two candidates (N-82), so a keyframe line is 13.1 x 2. A nine-picture reference set draws no new picture by itself (up to 9 come from the lock), so it is 0; its composition keyframe is charged above. A shared location reference is one picture.
h3_note: Credits by whole-second clip length, 3E.4's own table. Median job time 158 s, 9 in 10 within 306 s; a 4-second clip median 96 s, an 8-second clip 265 s.

omnihuman.note: 14 credits per whole second of audio, rounded up (56 for 4 s, 70 for 5, 140 for 10, 210 for 15, 420 for 30). Time: 25 of 27 jobs within 204 s (median 110, slowest 338); a 22-second piece took 213 s; lengths between are estimates until a run stamps them (3.3a).
